title: DECISION: reject-before-deliver ordering in sieve_delivery
description: sieve_delivery evaluates all recipient Sieve scripts and collects their actions before performing any delivery side effect. A second pass checks for any Reject action across all recipients; if found, the function returns immediately with SieveOutcome::Rejected before any message is written to any store. Alternative rejected: delivering to non-rejecting recipients while rejecting others in a single pass. That alternative is semantically wrong for SMTP: a DATA-phase rejection must be all-or-nothing per the RFC. If per-recipient rejection were needed, the SMTP server would need to use RCPT-phase rejection or per-recipient DSNs. Tradeoff: two passes over the actions list (small and in-memory), which is negligible cost for the correctness guarantee.
